notes.title: Dungeons of Legend: Cast Within Price Drop!
notes.content:
Dungeons of Legend: Cast Within can now be bought at half price!

Have fun exploring the dungeon, solving puzzles, fighting monsters and getting to the bottom of the sinister happenings in levels indoors and out!

notes.title: Dungeons of Legend: Underwell now available in Russian!
notes.content: The game has been fully localized in the Russian language. Some updates were also made to improve balance and difficulty.
